limitations: result_correct_proxy compares local SQLite result sets and is not the official BIRD EX grader.
Gold SQL is used only after inference for local result-set scoring and is never passed to the model provider.
Demo fixtures are smoke tests only and are not included in benchmark results.

cases.question: What is the rate of drivers completing all the laps in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rate
FROM results r1
JOIN races r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId
WHERE r2.year = 2008
AND r2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
AND r2.time IS NULL;

cases.question: What are the webpages for the Los Angeles County school that has between 2,000 and 3,000 test takers?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE UPPER(s.County) LIKE '%LOS ANGELES%'
AND sa.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;
cases.initial_sql:
SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE UPPER(s.County) LIKE '%LOS ANGELES%'
AND BETWEEN sa.NumTstTakr AND 3000;

cases.question: How much, in total, did client number 617 pay for all of the transactions in 1998?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN client c ON t.account_id IN (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN client cl ON a.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE cl.client_id = 617
)
WHERE t.date LIKE '1998%'
AND t.amount > 0;
